title: CARE-SD: Explainable Reasoning Architecture for Local SLM Self-Disclosure Analysis in Textual Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.21151v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cybersecurity interviews uncover critical security experiences, behaviors, and privacy concerns often not fully captured by conventional technical assessments. Consequently, identifying genuine self-disclosures is challenging because statements are context-dependent, categories overlap, and automated interpretations may introduce unsupported claims. Locally deployed Small Language Models (SLMs) protect sensitive participant data by keeping processing within controlled environments, but their limited reasoning capabilities make simple prompting insufficient for context-aware and factually reliable analysis. This study developed CARE-SD (Context-Adaptive Reasoning and Explanation for Self-Disclosure), a novel four-module architecture integrating context-adaptive processing, hierarchical disclosure reasoning, explanation-consistency verification, and cross-batch reconciliation. translated_title: CARE-SD：面向本地小型语言模型文本数据自我披露分析的可解释推理架构
translated_abstract: 网络安全访谈能够揭示关键的安全经验、行为和隐私担忧，而这些内容往往无法被传统的技术评估完全捕捉。因此，识别真实的自我披露极具挑战性，因为陈述高度依赖上下文、类别之间存在重叠，且自动化解释可能引入缺乏依据的论断。本地部署的小型语言模型（SLM）通过将数据处理保持在受控环境内来保护敏感的参与者数据，但其有限的推理能力使得简单的提示方法不足以实现具备上下文感知且事实可靠的分析。本研究开发了CARE-SD（Context-Adaptive Reasoning and Explanation for Self-Disclosure，面向自我披露的上下文自适应推理与解释），这是一种新颖的四模块架构，集成了上下文自适应处理、分层披露推理、解释一致性验证以及跨批次协调。我们评估了三个本地小型语言模型，包括Llama 1B、Qwen 1.5B等。
tldr: CARE-SD是一种新颖的四模块架构，通过上下文自适应处理、分层披露推理、解释一致性验证和跨批次协调，使本地部署的小型语言模型能够在保护数据隐私的前提下，对文本中的自我披露内容进行可靠且可解释的识别分析。
en_tdlr: CARE-SD is a novel four-module architecture that enables locally deployed small language models to reliably and explainably identify self-disclosures in text through context-adaptive processing, hierarchical disclosure reasoning, explanation-consistency verification, and cross-batch reconciliation, while keeping sensitive data protected in controlled environments.
